messages:
maria (release-ENG): Kickoff: rolling deploy v2.4.3 tonight 22:00 UTC. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Need final capacity + pin plan. @deploy-bot will start a US canary (10%).

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for us-west at 1749283410. Canary size 100 rps, model pinned v2.4.3-canary. I'll post metric updates here every 5m.

kevin: I can watch US warm pools. Current reserved GPU capacity: US 480 GPUs, EU 320, APAC 160. Cushion after warmup: US ~20%, EU ~18%, APAC ~12%.

sophie: APAC cushion looks tight. Ops: can we borrow 40 GPUs from US warm pool if EU/US headroom allows? What's cross-region failover latency?

andre (oncall): Failover time is ~45s to spin up containers + scheduler handoff. Cross-region fallback adds ~120–200ms network; prefer to use quantized fallback in-region first.

ajay: Recommend pin policy: US full rollout -> EU pinned to v2.4.3-lite (reduced batch targets) if EU p95 > 250ms. APAC default to v2.4.2-quantized fallback if capacity dips below 10% cushion.

maria (release-ENG): Agreed. Add a canary holdpoint after US 30m smoke. Proceed only if error rate < 0.5% and p95 <= 220ms. Quality evals must be within ±3% on core prompt set.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics stream will start at 1749283520. Posting 5m snapshots here. To abort early: react with :x: or send "deploy-bot abort" in this thread.

kevin: Smoke check/runbook snippet:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/health | jq .latency
./smoke.sh --q=100 --concurrency=20
```

sophie: I'll queue the smoke prompt set and trigger the lightweight eval harness. If we see quality regressions > +5% on key slices -> roll back immediately.

andre (oncall): Oncall checklist: ops-alerting channels configured, auto-fallback circuits set, and RBAC for pin overrides restricted to release team. I'll keep pager open.

maria (release-ENG): Release notes draft: "v2.4.3: routing policy improvements, batching tweaks, kernel selection fixes" — I'll post to #announcements after EU goes green. Add rollback steps and pinned fallback model names.

kevin: If EU spikes during ramp, throttle new sessions and pin EU to v2.4.2-quantized. APAC remains warmed but held at 0% traffic until EU stable.

ajay: Rollback window: keep previous configs pinned for 4 hours after final rollout. If we roll back, run the rollback checklist and open a postmortem within 48h.

sophie: :thumbsup: Monitoring dashboards configured, alert thresholds set. I'll be watching eval diffs and production prompts.

maria (release-ENG): Timeline recap: 22:00 UTC start US canary, 22:30 US holdpoint, 23:00 EU ramp if US green, 00:30 APAC ramp (hold). Ops on-call: @andre. deploy-bot will log all state changes here.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1749283520. First metric snapshot posted to thread. Good luck, team!"
